CITY OF BEVERLY HILLS
  455 North Rexford Drive
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210
  Video Teleconference
  Beverly Hills City Council Liaison / NEXT Beverly Hills Committee Meeting

  SPECIAL MEETING HIGHLIGHTS

  Thursday, June 13, 2024
  6:30 PM

MEETING CALLED TO ORDER
Date / Time:  June 13, 2024 / 6:30 PM
IN ATTENDANCE:  Mayor Lester Friedman, Councilmember Mary Wells, Deputy City Manager
  Keith Sterling, Director of Community Services Stephanie Harris, Director
  of Public Works Shana Epstein, NEXT Beverly Hills Committee Chair
  Charles Smith, NEXT Beverly Hills Committee Vice Chair Ellen Labbe

  1) Public Comment:

  None

  2) Welcome & Introductions:

  None

  3) NEXT Beverly Hills Mission Statement:
  a. NEXT Beverly Hills is a committee of talented next generation leaders focused on
  innovative initiatives which address lifestyle, economic, and civic needs of those in
  their 20s, 30s, and 40s chartered by the mayor and the city of Beverly Hills that
  seeks to engage all that are interested to inspire them and to make Beverly Hills a
  better place for all.

  4) New Business:
  a. Presentation by Shana Epstein:
  i. The Public Works Department has around 220 people.
  ii. The Public Works Department covers civil engineering, street services,
  transportation planning, streetlights, tenant relations, city parks, city
  facilities, AskBH, and capital improvement programs.
  iii. Capital improvement projects include the Burton Way Median Stormwater
  storage, the Burton Way resurfacing at the intersection of Burton Way and
  Rexford, installing level 2 EV chargers at city parking lots, upgrading city
 Highlights for June 13, 2024
NEXT Beverly Hills Committee

  fleet vehicles, conducting a mobility study at the Clifton-Le Doux corridor,
  restriping the La Cienega Tennis Court, constructing a well at 1945 S. La
  Cienega, acquiring the Gale Yard site, conducting holiday street lighting,
  upgrading the roll up doors at the Police Department, designing the
  permanent OpenBH program, renovating the stable doors at Greystone,
  upgrading the fire system alerts at the fire station, seismically retrofitting
  430 N Camden, replacing the water main in Coldwater canyon, upgrading
  the parking access revenue control system for city parking lots, installing
  automated license plate readers at all major points of entry into the city.
  b.  Waste in Beverly Hills is sorted for recycling.
  c.  For OpenBH, Public Works was involved with creating the guidelines for erecting
  the parklets in a public space.
  d.  The city found it more efficient to sort disposed waste for recycling than having it
  be done by residents.
  e.  The Holiday Lights on South Beverly are being redesigned this year.
  f.  The new Burton Way Reservoir holds around 1 million gallons.
  g.  The City switched from domestically supplied water to the Metropolitan Water
  District after the passage of the Clean Water Act, and the city found it cheaper to
  join the MWD than upgrade its old wells.
  h.  Most of the mini parks are old well sites.
  i.  The city’s modern wells were developed due to the MWD encouraging the
  development of local water sources due to the Colorado becoming unreliable for
  all of the MWD’s needs.
  j.  The City Council has approved for Next Night to be held on Saturday, September
  28th with the budget enhancement for the event being approved for 1 year.

  4) City Council Liaison Update – Civic Awareness Updates
  a. Councilmember Wells recommends that NEXT Beverly Hills have a booth at
  Festival Beverly Hills on July 21st to advertise themselves.
  b. The Architecture Commission and Design Review Commission have been
  consolidated into the Architectural Design Review Commission. The new
  commission will have six members for the near future until the Commissioners term
  out, following which it will be brought down to five.
  c. The Police Department’s usage of military equipment was reauthorized for the next
  year in accordance with state law.
  d. City Hall will be closed for Juneteenth.
  e. The first “Les is More, an Hour with the Mayor” will be held on Monday, June 24th
  at city hall from 6-7 PM.

  5) City Staff Announcements and upcoming events for the Next Generation:
  a. None

  6) Current Business:
 Highlights for June 13, 2024
NEXT Beverly Hills Committee

  a. If NEXT wants to connect with BHUSD for an event they should contact
  Community Services to facilitate a dialogue between the two.
  b. The School district is partnering with Not Today Cancer for a charity 5K on October
  6th.
  c. The North Portal of the D Line station at Beverly and Wilshire was cancelled due
  to cost.
  d. The next NEXT Beverly Hills meeting will be on Thursday, July 11th at 6:30 PM.

  7) Post Meeting Networking Session (Off-Site):

  8) Adjournment:
  Date / Time: June 13, 2024 / 7:32 PM
